Delhi Implements New Rules to Combat Winter Air Pollution

The Delhi government has introduced a comprehensive winter action plan to tackle severe air pollution. Key measures include mandating 50% work from home for government and private offices and requiring a valid pollution under control (PUC) certificate for vehicle refueling. These steps aim to reduce vehicular emissions and overall pollution during the high-risk winter months.
